name: search_documents
description:
Use this tool to search for authoritative, real-time knowledge and technical documentation for the Google Home ecosystem, including Google Home APIs, Matter, Cloud-to-cloud, and Thread. This tool serves as the official knowledge backbone for Google Home, bridging gaps in model training with domain-specific data to ensure high accuracy and reduce hallucinations.

Use this tool when users ask for specific technical guidance, API signatures, or architectural details that require specialized technical context. This tool returns the full markdown content of the most relevant matching documents in a single turn, providing comprehensive context for immediate reasoning. Each returned document contains a `source_url` field. When you use information from a document, you MUST cite the source by including its `source_url` in your response to the user.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of documents to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified, at most 10 documents will be returned. The maximum value is 30; values above 30 will be coerced to 30.

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous call to retrieve the next set of results.

query.description: Required. The natural language search query (e.g., "How to create an automation?").
